info.name: Historical vessel traffic within a radius

params.name: lat
params.description: Latitude of the zone center point. Requires lon.

params.name: lon
params.description: Longitude of the zone center point. Requires lat.

params.name: port_uuid
params.description: Port UUID to use as the zone center point.

params.name: port_unlocode
params.description: Port UN/LOCODE to use as the zone center point.

params.name: radius
params.description: Search radius in nautical miles. Maximum 50 NM.

params.name: days
params.description: Number of days back from today to return data for (for example days=5 returns the last 5 days).

params.name: from
params.description: Start date for the data in YYYY-MM-DD format. A maximum of 31 days may be requested from this date.

params.name: to
params.description: End date for the data in YYYY-MM-DD format.

items.docs: Replays past vessel traffic for a zone. Cost is calculated as the number of days multiplied by the number of vessels per day (maximum 500 vessels per day).

params.name: mmsi
params.description: Vessel Maritime Mobile Service Identity (9-digit number).

params.name: days
params.description: Number of days back from today to return data for (for example days=5 returns the last 5 days).

params.name: from
params.description: Start date for the data in YYYY-MM-DD format. A maximum of 31 days may be requested from this date.

params.name: to
params.description: End date for the data in YYYY-MM-DD format.

items.docs: Returns past AIS positions for a vessel identified by uuid, mmsi, or imo, filtered by a days lookback or an explicit from/to date range in YYYY-MM-DD format. A maximum of 31 days may be requested from the from date. Each day of data per vessel deducts 1 credit.
